dataset: Allowlisted official land-acquisition publication indexes for on-demand discovery
policy: Discovery yields notice candidates only. It never infers that land is acquired, awards are paid, or possession is taken. An authority must review the linked official notice/document and import structured values with evidence.

sources.authority: Department of Land Resources, Government of India / NIC
sources.scope: State/UT and project filtered report; requires selection in the public interface.

sources.authority: eGazette of India, Government of India
District Administration, Pune, Government of Maharashtra
sources.scope: District award catalogue; award PDF is required for case/parcel/compensation extraction.

sources.authority: District Administration, Nashik, Government of Maharashtra
sources.scope: District award catalogue; award PDF is required for case/parcel/compensation extraction.

sources.authority: District Administration, Gadchiroli, Government of Maharashtra
sources.scope: District notices include acquisition notifications and awards.

sources.authority: Department of Revenue and Disaster Management, Government of Puducherry
sources.scope: State notice index includes SIA, notifications, award-enquiry, award and compensation records.

sources.authority: Revenue and Disaster Management Department, Government of Odisha
sources.scope: State land-acquisition communications, declarations, SIA notices and LARRMS/Bhuarjan records.

sources.authority: Stationery and Printing Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
sources.scope: 2026 extraordinary gazette index, including land-acquisition notifications.
Revenue department government orders; individual order must be inspected for acquisition scope.
Industrial land and acquisition/allotment references; not a complete statewide acquisition register.
